checks.evidence: The user-authorized Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS x86_64 test VPS was successfully updated to 1.3.6-dev, the prerelease build of the 1.3.6 source. All five application containers were healthy after restart and the Windows WireGuard peer established a fresh handshake. Detailed update and health evidence is in docs/TESTING.md.

The configured public hostnames reached the VPS. After the update, normal TLS verification returned darkcry.com 200, admin.darkcry.com 200, and access.darkcry.com 403; ssl_verify_result was 0 for each. The provider firewall rules permit TCP 80/443 and UDP 51820, and the existing Caddy ACME certificates remained valid. See docs/TESTING.md.

The operator confirmed native Windows Jellyfin playback through the VPS after the 1.3.6-dev update. The imported WireGuard profile and scoped inbound firewall setup were confirmed in the earlier host gate; the updated VPS observed a fresh peer handshake. The update did not change the Windows client or firewall configuration.
